brief: Set on a span link. Describes the relationship between the span and the linked span.
additional_context: This attribute is exclusively set on span links.
Sentry instrumentation setting span links, sets it to describe the relationship between the span and the linked span.
Add each new link type to `enum_values`, with a brief that says what the linked span is.
A span can have links of different types. For example, a pageload span can have a `cache_origin` link and a `server_request` link.

enum_values.brief: The linked span is the root span of the trace before this trace, for example the pageload span before a navigation span.

The linked span produced the cached value that this span uses. For example, a `cache.get` span links the `cache.put` span that wrote the cache entry. A pageload span links the span that rendered the reused part of the page (see `page.server_rendering.type`).
The linked span published the queue message that this span processes.

The linked span handled the request for the document of this pageload span. Set only when the trace context of that request arrived too late, so the pageload span could not continue the trace. For a part of the page that the server reused from an earlier request, use `cache_origin`.

changelog.description: Added pageload examples to cache_origin and server_request
Removed next_trace from the examples and enum_values, because no SDK sets it
